name: Remix: Pragmatic Lexicon
description:
Pragmatic Lexicon is a modern, responsive vocabulary and flashcard learning app tailored for software engineers and tech professionals. It features a comprehensive dataset with dual-language support (English definitions and Tamil translations/examples), structured phonetic guides, parts of speech, synonyms, and antonyms.
Core Capabilities & Features
Interactive Feed & Views
Grid & List Views: Flexible display modes with smooth layout animations powered by Framer Motion.
A–Z Quick Jump: Alphabetical filter bar and category chips for fast navigation through the entire lexicon.
Dynamic Search & Filtering: Instant search across words, definitions, and Tamil translations, with filters for parts of speech (noun, verb, adjective) and bookmarked items.
Study & Flashcard Engine
Flashcard Study Mode: Interactive 3D flip card view with flip animations, progress tracking, and shuffle functionality for active recall practice.
Pronunciation & Speech Synthesis: Integrated browser Web Speech API for authentic English audio pronunciation.
Personalization & Persistence
Bookmark System: One-tap favoriting persisted via browser storage for focused offline study sessions.
Word Detail Modals: Deep-dive view showing full contextual examples, Tamil translations (taExample, taWord), and related word attributes.
